semiconductor_relevance: High — FononTech specializes in advanced semiconductor packaging through its innovative Impulse Printing technology, which enhances die bonding and interconnect solutions.
summary: FononTech is advancing the industrialization of impulse printing for semiconductor packaging, providing innovative 3D interconnect technology to major semiconductor manufacturers. Their IPS.1600m integration module enhances die bonding and wafer joining processes, targeting stencil/screen printing suppliers and die bonding manufacturers.
capabilities: IPS.1600m integration module for die bonding and wafer joining
Applications in wire bonding replacement and chip stacking

regional_presence.United States: FononTech has representative offices in the US, collaborating with major semiconductor customers.
regional_presence.South Korea: The company maintains a presence in South Korea to support its semiconductor collaborations.
regional_presence.Japan: FononTech has representatives in Japan, enhancing its reach in the semiconductor market.
